sentences.japanese: この日は、単に時間とお金の無駄だった。
sentences.english: This day was just a waste of time and money.

sentences.japanese: この世界には単に言葉では説明できないようなことがあるんだよ。
sentences.english: There are things in this world which simply cannot be expressed in the form of words.

sentences.japanese: 教育は単に多くの事実を学ぶことにあるわけでない。
sentences.english: Education does not consist simply in learning a lot of facts.

sentences.japanese: 教育は単に多くの事実を学ぶことにあるのではない。
sentences.english: Education does not consist simply in learning a lot of facts.

sentences.japanese: 科学は単に事実と方法論の集積では決してない。
sentences.english: Science is far more than a collection of facts and methods.
